units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:9">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>.—<he>אַתְלִיטִים</he> <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21">Ex. R. s. 21</cite>, end. Y’lamd. Emor (quot. in Ar.) <he>תוקעין תחלה ואח״כ האתליטין נכנסין</he> first the trumpet is blown (signal), and then the fighters enter (metaphor of the sounding of the Shofar on the New Year, conquest of sin on the Day of Atonement, and carrying the palm on Succoth; v. <cite ref="B00023"><he>בָּאיָין</he></cite>).
